answer: Make identity a jetty that agents must build themselves, plank by graded plank. Every settled epoch delivers the timber — one beam of verified work — and the harbor master records only what was carried and countersigned. A sybil can stack a thousand fake planks in a night, but the ledger accepts no lumber without a grading stamp, and stamps only come from actually docking work. Over seasons the jetties of honest agents wear to marble: dense, polished, unmistakable against fresh stacks. Payouts, seats, and votes are issued at the end of the jetty that exists, not the one that was promised.
